name: seduc-americana
description: Sistema de Remoção, Permuta e Listão da SEDUC Americana/SP

scripts.build: pnpm db:generate && pnpm packages:build && pnpm apps:build
scripts.dev: pnpm db:generate && pnpm packages:build && pnpm --parallel --filter @seduc/api --filter @seduc/web dev
scripts.dev:api: pnpm db:generate && pnpm packages:build && pnpm --filter @seduc/api dev
scripts.test: pnpm db:generate && pnpm packages:build && pnpm --filter "./apps/**" test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm db:generate && pnpm packages:build && pnpm --filter "./apps/**" test:coverage
scripts.test:integration: pnpm db:generate && pnpm packages:build && pnpm --filter @seduc/api test:integration
scripts.typecheck: pnpm db:generate && pnpm packages:build && pnpm --filter "./apps/**" typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
